sm_top.sm: An Israeli strike on a hospital in Gaza killed six people despite the active ceasefire.
Four oil tankers suffered explosions in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran's IRGC claimed to have targeted a U.S. radar in Bahrain, which the United States denied.
Ukraine targeted Russia with nearly 1,200 drones in a massive aerial attack.
Ansarallah forces complete the encirclement of Yemen's Aden in a major southern advance.
Ukraine reports that its drones struck a Russian warship nearly 1,000 kilometers away in the Baltic Sea.
Iranian state media report a strike on the US Navy's 5th Fleet headquarters and release visual proof of a destroyed military asset.
The UN reports 245 Palestinian children have been killed by Israeli forces in the West Bank since October 2023.
Car bombings in Russia killed a military officer and injured an ex-Ukraine PM adviser, with Moscow blaming Kyiv.
The Houthis conducted ballistic missile attacks targeting government staging areas in Lahij Governorate and a command headquarters in Aden City.
Iran claimed it targeted a US military radar in Bahrain in a retaliatory strike, while the US denied the claim.
Yemen's Houthis claim attacks on Saudi oil and military sites.
IDF says strikes in Gaza killed 10 operatives, including Oct. 7 terrorists
Israel hit Nasser Hospital in Gaza again amid accusations from Hamas
The Houthis claimed to have struck an unspecified Aramco facility in Riyadh with drones.
China conducts military exercises around Taiwan.
Al-Mehwar News reports violent clashes between Iraqi forces and armed groups in Kirkuk.
U.S. forces intercepted Iranian drones headed for Bahrain while Iran claimed a strike on a U.S. radar.
British spy planes conducted a month-long reconnaissance mission monitoring a Russian enclave following nuclear threats.
Iraq reopens a decades-old oil route through Syria amid Strait of Hormuz disruptions.
Salvadoran troops seized Haiti's national stadium, establishing a military base with robot dogs assisting, amid anti‑gang operations.
US forces shot down Iranian drones as Trump pulled JD Vance out of talks.
Japan pledged drones and a coastal defense radar in a $27 million defense transfer package to the Philippines.
US President Trump states that the US could consider a military operation against Cuba.
Yemeni officials condemn the Israeli bombing of the Nasser Medical Complex in Gaza.
A new rebel offensive is reported in the eastern DR Congo.
The Iranian navy shot down a US MQ-1 drone near the Strait of Hormuz.
The IRGC reports that a gas carrier is on fire after striking a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
The UN warns that ongoing Israeli attacks have pushed Gaza's health system to the brink of collapse.
Nigeria's Department of State Services (DSS) intercepted a major arms shipment originating from the Niger Republic in Sokoto, foiling a terror plot.
The IRGC Aerospace Force warned of an unlimited response over the Strait of Hormuz following a strike in Sirik.
Reports indicate a large number of missiles were launched in western Iran.
Colombia's JEP peace court indicted former military officials over paramilitary atrocities and crimes against the Patriotic Union.
State media reported an enemy strike hit southern Iran's Sirik County near the Strait of Hormuz.
US forces intercepted Iranian drones over the Gulf
The Israeli military announces it struck and killed more than 10 operatives in the Gaza Strip over the past week and bombed a weapons production site.
An oil tanker was left ablaze off the UAE coast amid ongoing attacks on Gulf shipping.
Saudi airstrikes intensify fighting in Yemen, resulting in the displacement of thousands of people.
Houthis launched a combined‑arms offensive in Lahij Governorate, with significant fighting reported near Ras al Arah Camp.
An enemy strike hit Sirik in Iran's Hormozgan province.
